authority: single canonical primitive list and derivation contract for every active skill in every Windows and WSL harness

primitives.title: Execute the skill contract
primitives.contract: Interpret the selected skill's purpose, inputs, outputs, constraints and completion criteria before taking action.
primitives.input: skill name, description, explicit dependencies and instructions
primitives.output: an executable plan whose steps are primitive skill invocations
primitives.completion: the selected skill's declared output is produced or its declared blocker is returned

primitives.title: Read local context
primitives.contract: Read only the local files, directories, metadata, configuration or schemas needed for the task.
primitives.input: local paths and a bounded read budget
primitives.output: a provenance-bearing context slice
primitives.completion: the required context is read or the missing path is named

primitives.title: Search and retrieve knowledge
primitives.contract: Search an approved local or remote knowledge source and return candidate records with provenance.
primitives.input: query, source scope, freshness and result limit
primitives.output: ranked candidate records or an explicit no-match result
primitives.completion: the query is answered within the declared source and coverage bounds

primitives.title: Fetch an external source
primitives.contract: Fetch an authorized source through its official API, connector or structured endpoint and preserve provenance.
primitives.input: source identifier, URL or API request plus authorization scope
primitives.output: the source payload and provenance metadata
primitives.completion: the source response is obtained and validated or the access failure is named

primitives.title: Extract structured content
primitives.contract: Parse text, documents, HTML, PDF, OCR or media metadata into a structured representation without inventing content.
primitives.input: source bytes or text plus extraction profile
primitives.output: structured content with source locators
primitives.completion: the requested fields or passages are extracted and their provenance is retained

primitives.title: Transform content
primitives.contract: Transform supplied content while preserving facts, provenance and the requested language, format or style.
primitives.input: source content and transformation contract
primitives.output: transformed content plus transformation receipt
primitives.completion: the transformed content satisfies the declared format and fact-preservation checks

primitives.title: Analyze data
primitives.contract: Compute declared statistics, models, evaluations or comparisons and expose assumptions and uncertainty.
primitives.input: dataset, metric definitions and analysis constraints
primitives.output: analysis result, assumptions and diagnostic evidence
primitives.completion: the declared metric is computed and checked against the acceptance criteria

primitives.title: Implement and test code
primitives.contract: Create or change code and prove the intended behavior with deterministic checks while preserving unrelated behavior.
primitives.input: codebase context, change contract and acceptance tests
primitives.output: code change, test evidence and rollback information
primitives.completion: the acceptance tests pass or the precise implementation blocker is reported

primitives.title: Execute an automation
primitives.contract: Execute a bounded command, script, workflow or scheduled action through an authorized runner.
primitives.input: command or workflow, scope, timeout and authorization
primitives.output: execution result, exit status and side-effect receipt
primitives.completion: the bounded action finishes and its result is read back

primitives.title: Interact with a browser or desktop
primitives.contract: Observe and interact with an authorized browser or desktop UI, recording the actions and their evidence.
primitives.input: target application, action contract and safety scope
primitives.output: UI state, actions taken and resulting evidence
primitives.completion: the requested UI state is reached or the interaction failure is diagnosed

primitives.title: Process media
primitives.contract: Process image, audio or video media with an explicit toolchain and retain the original plus readable derivatives.
primitives.input: media asset, processing profile and output constraints
primitives.output: processed media, metadata and readable derivative
primitives.completion: the requested media output exists and its integrity is verified

primitives.title: Route or classify a decision
primitives.contract: Classify a bounded case or select among declared routes, including an explicit null or human-review route.
primitives.input: closed decision space, evidence state and decision policy
primitives.output: selected route, confidence or abstention, and rationale
primitives.completion: one declared route is selected or the case is routed to review without a forced answer

primitives.title: Manage durable task state
primitives.contract: Create or update checkpoints, memory, queues or resumable state with atomic writes and explicit ownership.
primitives.input: state transition, owner and durability boundary
primitives.output: updated state, checkpoint or recovery receipt
primitives.completion: the transition is durable, readable and safe to resume

primitives.title: Persist a durable artifact
primitives.contract: Persist a new or changed artifact in its canonical managed location, read it back and register its identity.
primitives.input: artifact bytes, logical identity, canonical parent and evidence
primitives.output: canonical object, readback receipt and discoverability record
primitives.completion: readback and identity registration pass or the artifact remains unvalidated

primitives.title: Verify evidence and completeness
primitives.contract: Check claims, hashes, tests, schemas, provenance and readback against explicit acceptance criteria.
primitives.input: candidate result, acceptance criteria and source evidence
primitives.output: PASS or FAIL verdict with machine-readable evidence
primitives.completion: every mandatory criterion is decided and a failure names its blocker

primitives.title: Authorize identity and scope
primitives.contract: Resolve the acting identity, consent, permissions and egress scope before protected work proceeds.
primitives.input: requested action, principal, policy and available authorization evidence
primitives.output: authorized scope, denied scope and audit reference
primitives.completion: the action is explicitly authorized or denied without a partial fallback

primitives.title: Deliver a notification
primitives.contract: Deliver a concise result to an authorized human or team surface and retain delivery proof.
primitives.input: message, audience, channel capability and authorization
primitives.output: delivery receipt with message identifier
primitives.completion: the authorized surface accepts the message and returns a delivery receipt

primitives.title: Escalate to human judgment
primitives.contract: Present the decision-relevant facts, alternatives and trade-offs for an authorized human decision.
primitives.input: decision context, options, evidence and risk boundary
primitives.output: human decision or an explicit pending state
primitives.completion: the human decides or explicitly defers; the agent does not substitute a preference
the run context exists, every precondition is verified or named as missing, and the ledger is initialized
primitives.contract: Establish a reproducible experiment context before any attempt: agree a run tag, create the isolated branch or workspace, read the in-scope files, verify the required data and cache are present, and create the empty results ledger.
primitives.input: run tag, in-scope file list, data or cache requirements, ledger schema
primitives.output: initialized run context, verified preconditions and an empty results ledger
primitives.title: Initialize a reproducible experiment run

primitives.completion: a candidate exists that satisfies every guard rule, or the candidate is rejected with the violated rule named
primitives.contract: Produce one candidate research artifact from the current incumbent under a declared guard, such as a source-size limit, an import allowlist, a denied-call list or a response schema, without mutating the incumbent until the candidate is accepted.
primitives.input: incumbent artifact, task or hypothesis, guard rules and output schema
primitives.output: one candidate artifact plus the guard verdict that admitted or rejected it
primitives.title: Propose a guarded candidate change

primitives.completion: the metric is read from the run log, or the run is classified as crashed with its failure evidence
primitives.contract: Execute the candidate under a fixed time budget or fixed workload, capture exactly one comparable metric from the run log, and classify a crash as a first-class outcome instead of a missing value.
primitives.input: candidate artifact, fixed budget, metric definition, dataset and log target
primitives.output: metric value, budget consumption, resource peak and an explicit crash classification
primitives.title: Run a bounded experiment and capture the metric

primitives.completion: the row and the event are readable back and the checkpoint resumes the loop
primitives.contract: Append one schema-conformant row per attempt to the durable results ledger and one event to the event log, and checkpoint the campaign state so the loop can be resumed after any interruption.
primitives.input: attempt outcome, metric, ledger schema, checkpoint boundary and owner
primitives.output: appended ledger row, appended event and a durable checkpoint
primitives.title: Append the attempt to the durable results ledger

primitives.completion: one verdict is emitted with its evidence and the branch or workspace reflects it
primitives.contract: Compare the candidate metric with the incumbent metric under the declared acceptance rule, apply the declared tie-breaker such as the simplicity criterion, and emit exactly one of keep, discard or crash with the reason.
primitives.input: candidate metric, incumbent metric, acceptance rule and tie-breaker
primitives.output: keep, discard or crash verdict with the comparison evidence and the resulting revert or advance action
primitives.title: Keep or discard the candidate against the incumbent

primitives.completion: the campaign is allowed to start with a positive preflight verdict, or it is stopped with the blocking reason named
primitives.contract: Confirm provider authentication, model reachability and remaining quota with one minimal request before a campaign starts, and stop the campaign closed on authentication failure, rate limiting, explicit low quota or repeated transient failure.
primitives.input: provider endpoint, credential reference, model identifier and quota endpoint
primitives.output: preflight verdict with the quota state, the model in use and the reason a campaign must not start
primitives.title: Verify provider credentials and quota before spending tokens

derivation.rule: A skill is valid only when its derived composition contains the baseline primitive and every additional primitive resolves to this registry. Explicit primitive IDs are authoritative but unknown IDs fail closed.
notes: The composition map is derived and rebuildable; source SKILL.md files remain original and are not rewritten in place.
The active boundary is a direct child of a registered skills root that exposes SKILL.md; nested examples, references and vendor payloads are not independently loadable skills.
Copies with the same name and different bytes are separate content variants and each receives its own composition.
Archives, snapshots, rollback trees, vendor imports and filesystem backup trees are not active skill surfaces.

Autoresearch loop primitives (experiment.*, candidate.propose, quota.preflight) are anchored on karpathy/autoresearch program.md and on the harness-local autoresearch-minimax-api adaptation; each addition keeps the baseline primitive mandatory.
